web-guide-idea-13.audience: People fascinated by local trade, makers and everyday markets.
web-guide-idea-13.offer: Curate a market visit around one theme such as flowers or spices. Viewers pay for your access, introductions and explanations, rather than a random shopping broadcast.
web-guide-idea-13.steps.0: Agree filming with a few vendors.
web-guide-idea-13.steps.1: Show how goods are selected, arranged or used.
web-guide-idea-13.steps.2: Compare a few examples and take questions from a quieter corner.
web-guide-idea-13.equipment: A phone, power bank and a small microphone if the market is noisy. Keep customer payments out of frame.
web-guide-idea-13.returnReason: Follow seasonal products and introduce a different consenting vendor. Your relationships make the series distinctive.
web-guide-idea-13.promotion: Feature one product and a vendor-approved introduction. Do not promise purchases or delivery unless that is a separate supported service.
web-guide-idea-13.metadataTitle: Bazaar Live — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · Saathum
web-guide-idea-13.metadataDescription: Explore a flower market, spice bazaar or weekly haat and introduce the people and products with permission. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
